name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
title: Sugs Lloyd Ltd - 544501 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up ~70% to INR300 crore with margins held near 14%, but receivables are stretched, Q4 carried 40% of sales, and the INR600+ crore order is 18-24 month execution with thin disclosure on capex and working capital.

triggers.label: Receivables stretched; Q4 = 40% of sales
triggers.quote: majority, 40% of our sales has happened in Q4

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR600 crore reiterated
triggers.quote: Yes, it is very much achievable. We are on line.

triggers.label: Order book INR825 crore; INR640 crore SCADA order
triggers.quote: Our order book as of now stands around INR825 crores

triggers.label: Price variation clauses protect margins
triggers.quote: majority of our orders are with price variation clause

triggers.label: Q4 margin dip blamed on one-off MAHAGENCO delay
triggers.quote: there had been certain, you know, interference from local political, you know, fraternity

guidance.quote: Yes, it is very much achievable. We are on line.
Our target of INR1,000 crores revenue by financial year '28 is firmly on track.
We intend a contribution of around 10% of the total revenue from FPIs.

prior_guidance_check.quote: delivering a turnover of INR300 crores against our stated guidance of INR270 crores

red_flags.label: Receivables rising; Q4 concentration
red_flags.quote: Improving receivables is our top priority and we are working hard on it.

red_flags.label: Creditor days stretched 18 to 61
red_flags.quote: our earlier creditor days which used to be 18 days, this year we have brought it to 61 days

red_flags.label: Fund-based limits 49 of 60 crore used; credit rated BBB minus
red_flags.quote: against INR60 crores fund-based, the utilized was INR49 crores

red_flags.label: Order-book reconciliation gap and GST inclusion
red_flags.quote: The order of INR640 crores is inclusive of 18% GST.

evasions.quote: it is very difficult to say when we will be able to receive those
we may not be able to comment exactly on the figures, on the margins for FPIs
numbers will have to go through, Mishra
